packageRules.description: Hold every update for 2 days after release so it clears pnpm's minimumReleaseAge supply-chain gate (24h cutoff in CI). Avoids ERR_PNPM_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE_VIOLATION on freshly published versions.

Every lockfile-touching PR invalidates every other one on merge, and each rebase costs a full pipeline. Collapse all non-major updates (any manager, any file: root package.json, docker/migrator/package.json, lockfile-only) into one weekly minor PR and one weekly patch PR so a merge cascade is two pipelines, not N. Majors stay separate so a breaking bump cannot hold the rest hostage.
kysely is pinned via pnpm.overrides for better-auth compatibility; 0.29.x removes DEFAULT_MIGRATION_TABLE and breaks the Next build. Do not update until better-auth no longer needs the pin.

better-call is pinned via pnpm.overrides to the version better-auth 1.6.x depends on (1.3.6). better-auth imports serializeCookie/kAPIErrorHeaderSymbol from better-call's root, which the 2.x major renamed/dropped; bumping the override past 1.3.x breaks the build and tests. The override exists to force a single better-call instance (kAPIErrorHeaderSymbol is a Symbol whose identity must match). Do not update until better-auth itself moves to better-call 2.x.

better-auth 1.7 is a breaking change despite the minor version. Account gains a required `issuer` field and its unique index moves from [accountId, providerId] to [issuer, accountId], so prisma/schema.prisma and both migration trees need a hand-authored migration that backfills existing rows. genericOAuth also now throws at init when discovery is unreachable instead of logging and continuing, which would break auth boot in lib/oidc.ts whenever the IdP is briefly down. 1.7.2 also wants better-call 1.4.0, which the pnpm.overrides pin above holds at 1.3.6. Hold until that migration lands.
ESLint 10 is not yet supported by eslint-config-next 16.x (its rules use a removed API, breaking `eslint .`). Hold the major until eslint-config-next supports it.

TypeScript 7 (native/Go compiler) is not yet supported by the toolchain: typescript-eslint peers on `typescript <6.1.0` (crashes with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'Cjs')`) and Next.js does not detect TS 7 as an installed TypeScript, failing `next build`. Hold the major until typescript-eslint and Next support it.
